# TASK-652: Directory change journal with replay

## Goal

Replace the per-file targeted stream with one directory-level FSEvents stream whose event ID is persisted, so sleep and relaunch replay; collapse changes into capped dirty sets per capacity interval and expose changed directories through explain_growth.

## Deliverables

- Change journal with persisted replay
- explain_growth changed-directory answer
- TCC observation note

- Sources/DiskStewardCore/**

## Acceptance Criteria

- `AC-TASK-652-01` — One directory-level stream (no kFSEventStreamCreateFlagFileEvents) covers the configured scopes; lastEventId and the volume's FSEvents UUID are persisted at each capacity sample; relaunch replays from the stored ID until HistoryDone; a UUID change, MustScanSubDirs, EventIdsWrapped or dropped events are reported as journal gaps, never as no change.
- `AC-TASK-652-02` — Changed directories collapse to the nearest object or project root in a per-interval dirty set capped at 2,000 entries (overflow collapses to the parent) and retained for 7 days; explain_growth returns the capacity delta for the requested window, the changed directories (unmeasured) and any gaps.
- `AC-TASK-652-03` — Record whether changes inside Documents, Desktop and Downloads are delivered without Full Disk Access, validating ASM-604.

## Required Evidence

- `EVREQ-TASK-652-01` (regression-evidence) — Real FSEvents fixtures on a temporary directory: replay across a restart, gap flags, cap overflow.
- `EVREQ-TASK-652-02` (research-note) — TCC delivery observation with the exact macOS version.
